name: Can an above-ground pool be demolished too?

mainEntity.name: Is above-ground pool removal different from in-ground pool demolition in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Is above-ground pool removal different from in-ground pool demolition in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Above-ground pools can absolutely be removed, and the process is usually simpler than in-ground pool demolition. Instead of breaking a deep concrete or gunite shell, the crew typically disassembles the structure, removes liner and frame components, disconnects utilities if present, and clears the site. Costs are usually lower because there is less excavation, less hauling, and less backfill. That said, the final price still depends on decking, equipment pads, attached spas, and site access. Homeowners should ask whether the contractor includes dismantling, haul-off, and cleanup, and whether any deck repair will be needed after the pool comes out. Above-ground removal is often a straightforward project, but it still benefits from a clear written scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Above-ground pools are usually faster and cheaper to remove because they do not require deep excavation or extensive backfill. The main tasks are disassembly, debris removal, and site cleanup rather than full shell demolition.
